title: Move 'connecting for' message underneath profile / tt bar
body:
Feature request. The 'connecting for' message covers the ability to change profile or temp target. It would be nice if it appeared underneath so you could change tt rather than waiting for the connection first.
![Screenshot_20210827-133945_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/8146651/131138936-22da9420-b41d-4156-a277-5880a3861d0a.jpg)
